deadline.bestiary.anima: Lost souls. Invisible except to the camera or UV light. They leave an unmistakable chill.
deadline.bestiary.monja: An expelled nun who made a pact. She only moves in darkness. Light freezes and burns her.
deadline.bestiary.muneca: Possessed porcelain. It only moves when nobody is looking.
deadline.bestiary.poseida: Lucia played with a spirit board. Something answered. She climbs walls, levitates and cannot be jarred: only exorcised.
deadline.bestiary.sombra: Seen by those who have lost their minds. Look at it and it disappears. Look away and it comes closer.
deadline.case.casa.hint: Lucia's doll is in the basement.
deadline.case.casa.msg.0: Please... my daughter Lucia is not herself. She speaks languages she never learned. Last night we found her walking on the ceiling.
deadline.case.casa.msg.1: I visited the Morales family. What I saw in that room is not an illness. We need an exorcist. Today.
deadline.case.casa.msg.2: There is screaming every night at the Morales house. The girl's dolls keep showing up in my garden.
deadline.case.casa.msg.3: The lights turn off by themselves. My daughter laughs in the basement... but the basement is locked.
deadline.case.casa.msg.4: ...hello? They won't let me out. Come play with me. I'm in my room.
deadline.case.colegio.hint: What they are looking for is down below, in the crypt.
deadline.case.colegio.msg.0: Please, come to Saint Agnes School. The choir girls are still singing backwards. It has been the same night for forty-two years. And don't speak loudly: she listens.
deadline.case.colegio.msg.1: Look, they pay me to mow the lawn, not for this. The school has been closed since '84 and every night the recess bell rings. Last night my name showed up on the blackboard. Misspelled. I'm not going back in.
deadline.case.colegio.msg.2: (a choir of little girls sings a nursery rhyme... backwards. At the end, a single voice:) ...present.
deadline.case.colegio.msg.3: I must ask for absolute discretion. Saint Agnes School has not existed since 1984. If anyone asks, you were never there.
deadline.case.colegio.place: Saint Agnes of the Vigil School
deadline.colegio.ch.1.sub: Saint Agnes of the Vigil School
deadline.colegio.ch.4.sub: You are wanted over the PA.
deadline.colegio.hint.aula: Roll call is taken in 6th grade.
deadline.colegio.hint.confesar: The confessional is in the chapel.
deadline.colegio.hint.direccion: They called you over the PA.
deadline.colegio.hint.dormitorio: Move with the moonlight. Freeze when it clouds over.
deadline.colegio.hint.entrar: The door is open. Too open.
deadline.colegio.hint.llave: The keys hang in the kitchen. The kitchen is dark.
deadline.colegio.obj.coro: Go up to the choir loft.
deadline.colegio.obj.dormitorio: Cross the dormitory without a sound.
deadline.colegio.obj.espejo: Read the diary in the bathroom mirror.
deadline.colegio.obj.llave: Find the key in the kitchen.
deadline.colegio.obj.regla: Find the ruler in the crypt.
deadline.colegio.obj.rezar: Take lectern 8 and pray out loud.
deadline.colegio.obj.silencio: Get out of the Silence Room.
deadline.colegio.stamp.danos: For damage to the building. Your parents will be notified.
deadline.colegio.stamp.gritar: For shouting in the Lord's house.
deadline.colegio.stamp.lista: For not answering the roll call.
deadline.line.colegio.clara.1984: Is anyone there? ...Please... I told them to take me... me...
deadline.line.colegio.clara.dormitorio: Don't turn on the light in the dormitory. And if you see me sitting... don't stare at me.
deadline.line.colegio.clara.falta_voz: One voice is missing. One was always missing.
deadline.line.colegio.clara.gracias: Thank you for coming. I called in 1984 and nobody came. Who passed you my call? ...Be careful with whoever calls you with your own voice.
deadline.line.colegio.clara.llamada: Sorry for calling so late... I can't speak up, she listens. Saint Agnes School. If you see her, turn everything off... no, no, the other way! Turn everything on. Light burns her. And please... no running in the halls.
deadline.line.colegio.clara.ya_sabe: Now you know who I am. Don't pity me. What they want is down below.
deadline.line.colegio.cura.ave: Hail Mary most pure... Tell me, son.
deadline.line.colegio.cura.r1: Three Hail Marys and don't do it again.
deadline.line.colegio.cura.r2: That's not a sin, that's bad taste.
deadline.line.colegio.cura.r3: Are you done? I have a barbecue on the grill.
deadline.line.colegio.cura.r4: Tell me something, son... did we win another World Cup?
deadline.line.colegio.madre.megafonia: The new student is wanted in the Principal's office. Immediately.
deadline.line.colegio.madre.pregunta1: First question. How many were in the choir? A, seven. B, eight. C, twelve. D, no idea, miss.
deadline.line.colegio.madre.pregunta2: Second question. Who punishes? A, the Mother. B, Sister Maria. C, God. D, your mom.
deadline.line.colegio.madre.usted: And you? What is your name?
deadline.line.colegio.paloma.chiste1: Knock knock. Who's there? The nun. The nun who? ...The one behind you.
deadline.line.colegio.paloma.chiste2: Wanna know a secret? Sister Agony snores.
deadline.line.operadora.aviso: DEAD LINE informs you that this call may be recorded for exorcism purposes. Thank you for choosing us.
deadline.line.operadora.muerte: DEAD LINE reminds you that death does not exempt you from payment.
deadline.msg.anchor_purified: §b✟ Object purified.§r The entity is now vulnerable.
deadline.msg.anchored: §8Something protects it... find its cursed object.
deadline.msg.case_failed: §4Case failed:§r %s. The entity is still there.
deadline.msg.needs_exorcism: §cIt will not fit in a jar. It needs an exorcism.
deadline.msg.stage_exorcise: §6It is bound!§r Hold the §bBook of Rites§r near it to exorcise it.
deadline.msg.stage_jar: §6It is weakened!§r Trap it with the §bSpirit Jar§r.
deadline.msg.welcome: §4[DEAD LINE]§r Your phone is on. Keep it close: someone is going to call.
deadline.objective.0: Find the cursed object and purify it with holy water
deadline.objective.1: The entity is vulnerable: weaken it
deadline.objective.2: Trap it with the Spirit Jar
deadline.objective.2x: Exorcise it with the Book of Rites
deadline.phone.locked: You have not met it yet.
deadline.text.colegio.diario: 21/6. I hear them singing backwards. They did it without me. There were seven. THE BOOK SAYS EIGHT.
deadline.text.colegio.legajo: Religious name: Sister Maria of the Agony. Secular name: CLARA INES BUSTOS. Discharged: 22/6/1984. "Not on record. Not to be searched for."
deadline.text.colegio.oracion.1: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
deadline.text.colegio.oracion.2: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
deadline.text.colegio.oracion.3: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
deadline.text.colegio.reglamento: 1. Silence. 2. In this school we walk. No running. 3. Every voice will be heard.
deadline.text.colegio.reglas: LIGHT BURNS HER. IF YOU MAKE NOISE, SHE ALREADY HEARD YOU. NO RUNNING IN THE HALLS.
